title: Retro halftone cartoon
summary: A generated 1960s collage-cartoon character on chroma green, keyed over a generated plate that scrolls left. Scene: an ice-cream van on a coast road.

optional.what: an image model, to make your own character and plate from prompts/
optional.cost: free to a few cents an image, by tool
options: Codex's built-in image tool (on a ChatGPT plan)
any model that follows a long style prompt and paints on flat #00B140 green

optional.what: a lip-sync video model, to replace the stand-in with a singing clip (prompts/03_clip.yml)
optional.cost: paid: about 34 Higgsfield credits per 10 s for MiniMax H3 Max
options: MiniMax H3 Max in reference mode (Higgsfield or Fal)
any lip-sync model that takes a still and a vocal and keeps a locked camera on green

stand_ins: the character is a still animated in code (bob, squash, rock on the beat); it does not sing until a lip-sync clip replaces it
keep: the style bible in prompts/style.txt, pasted verbatim into every image prompt
